extracted.name: Mint Julep
extracted.description: Whether you make this mint julep recipe for a Kentucky Derby party or another occasion, it's bound to be a hit! This classic bourbon cocktail is aromatic and refreshing.
ingredient_lines: 8 fresh mint leaves (plus more for garnish)
¼ to ½ ounce Simple Syrup
instruction_lines: In a julep cup, muddle the mint leaves in ¼ ounce simple syrup. Add the bourbon and fill the cup with crushed ice.
Stir until the cup becomes frosted on the outside. Taste, adding more simple syrup for a sweeter drink.
Top with more crushed ice to create a dome and garnish with more mint.
